snippet.title: Who Should You Be Kindest To? 💛 Your Mother! | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Who should you be the kindest to, in the whole wide world?

A man came to our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) and asked who deserved his kindness the most. The answer was: "Your mother." Then who? "Your mother." Then who? "Your mother." Then who? "Your father."

Your mum looked after you when you were tiny. So today, give her a big hug and help her with a smile! How will your little one help mum today?

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 5971: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:5971

We never show any Prophet or Companion. All characters are faceless.
